speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV) - the patient describes a constant sensation of the room spinning which is atypical for BPPV (usually episodic), but the relief with diphenhydramine and lack of other focal neurological deficits makes vestibular migraine or viral labyrinthitis more likely. However, given the "constant" nature since morning, I will first rule out a central cause. Has you experienced any headache, double vision, difficulty speaking, or weakness in your arms or legs?
